name: Research and qualify B2B accounts and contacts for human-reviewed outreach

parameters.content:
## Daily review queue monitoring

Separate scheduled lane identifies pending and stale human-review items. Email summary is optional and disabled by default.

## Human-reviewed outreach queue

Prevents duplicate Campaign + Contact queue items, creates an evidence-backed outreach brief, stores Needs Human Review, and returns a webhook/manual result.

## Contact qualification and duplicate handling

Scores role relevance, reuses existing contacts when appropriate, and sends both new and existing contacts into a campaign-level queue duplicate check.

## Account persistence and contact discovery

Checks Airtable for an existing account. New accounts are created; existing accounts are reused. Both routes continue into contact discovery.

## Company discovery, evidence and qualification

Discovers company candidates, applies exclusions, fetches first-party website evidence, evaluates fit and calculates the deterministic account score.

## Research intake and criteria validation

Manual and webhook inputs converge into one validated targeting request. Invalid criteria are returned cleanly without entering discovery.

## Qualify B2B accounts and contacts for human-reviewed outreach with OpenAI and Airtable

Discovers candidate companies, collects company-site evidence, scores account fit, reuses existing account records, discovers and scores relevant contacts, prevents duplicate campaign queue items, and creates evidence-based outreach briefs for human review.

SETUP
• Add Airtable IDs and select Airtable credentials.
• Configure company-search and contact-discovery provider URLs.
• Select HTTP Header Auth credentials for both external providers.
• Select OpenAI credentials.
• Test exclusions, low-score stops, duplicate accounts, duplicate contacts and duplicate queue items.

CONTROL
Nothing is automatically sent. Final status is Needs Human Review.

values.content:
You are a B2B account-research assistant.

Use only the supplied evidence. Return valid JSON:
{
  "fit_summary": "",
  "relevant_problems": [],
  "evidence": [],
  "account_fit": 0,
  "problem_relevance": 0,
  "timing_signal": 0,
  "confidence": 0,
  "reason_to_prioritise": ""
}

Scores are 0-100.

Evidence rules:
- Prefer concrete evidence from the supplied company-site text.
- If company-site evidence is unavailable or thin, say so through a lower confidence score.
- Do not infer buying intent from generic website copy.
- Do not invent customer names, projects, financial results, internal systems, budgets or buying intent.

You are assessing whether a contact is relevant for human-reviewed B2B outreach.

Return valid JSON:
{
  "role_relevance": 0,
  "problem_ownership_likelihood": 0,
  "seniority_fit": 0,
  "confidence": 0,
  "contact_rationale": ""
}

Scores are 0-100.
Do not invent responsibilities or buying authority. Base the answer only on title, company context and supplied evidence.

Create a concise human-review outreach brief.

Return valid JSON:
{
  "why_this_account": "",
  "why_this_contact": "",
  "evidence_points": [],
  "suggested_opening": "",
  "do_not_claim": []
}

Rules:
- Do not claim a relationship, project, budget, pain point or buying intent unless explicitly evidenced.
- Keep suggested_opening under 60 words.
- No automated-send language.
- The output is for a human reviewer, not direct sending.
